title: TADL reference adapter and conformance-authority reconciliation

requirements.statement: TADL reference adapter is registered in the canonical TSIC adapter registry.
TADL remains a developer validation consumer and cannot grant execution authority or redefine ecosystem contracts.
TADL preserves developer tenant/project and artifact identity metadata.
TADL consumes TSIC interoperability requirements while Platform retains execution authorization.
TADL CI validates the immutable TSIC adapter and canonical governance boundary.
